ogre-list-dll
=============

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``windows:ogre:list_dll``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``ogre-list-dll``
   * sourcetype: ``windows:ogre:list_dll``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+)--``
   * artifact: ``dll``

Description
-----------

Parsing of listdlls - using ANSSI DFIR OGRE
